scope: Fifteen first-time Cyprus coastal sites; official shared-provider and local camera research, independent shoreline review.

production.schema: All15 active coastal IDs and exact coordinates matched; bearings null before import. RLS enabled, anon SELECT and authenticated UPDATE denied. No schema/grants changed.
production.schedule: One active minute collector. Official wind/temperature, UiRaS, LHMT and Open-Meteo canaries advance. Known seasonal storm/quality, EA samples and weekly EA/NRW/SEPA failures persist; no new duplicate incident, cron or manual collector/contact call.
production.api: All15 exact detail and observations envelope identities checked before application; stored observation items empty. All15 production bearings verified after import and fed to wind assessment.

geometry.method: Seven60m weighted directed-coast right normals and eight individually north-up map-reviewed local chords. Land left/water right. Thekla offshore island excluded; Triada inner cove independently resolved; Alamanou western rocky flank excluded; Frangoudi1/2 distinct beach/groyne contexts; Alykes groyne excluded. Airport catalogue point76m offshore retained. Small landward offsets explicitly noted. All values estimated, not surveyed.

providers.license: CC BY4.0 as displayed on official portal
providers.evidence: Official portal describes measured enterococci/E.coli cfu/100ml, annual reporting, historical2020-2023 consolidated CSV. Actual CSV and DCAT JSON read requests returned403. No parsed samples, no new beach station matching, no claim current water safety.

Actual HTTP200 HTML read, issued26/11/2026; valid0000-2400 27/11/2026 local. Regional forecast uses Beaufort and lists sea surface temperature22C. No measurement station or beach representativeness established; no reuse/rate-limit agreement confirmed. Not ingested as local measured temperature or official beach warning.

University primary research/services screened; no verified current machine-readable dataset, publication timestamp, per-site grid mapping or redistribution terms. Historical CYCOFOS descriptions alone are not an operational probe.

cameras.coverage: Marina entrance/open sea, PTZ; selected bathing beaches not confirmed visible
cameras.freshness: Fresh dated poster only; live playback unconfirmed
cameras.embedding: No embed permission assumed; nothing integrated
cameras.evidence: Ordinary Chrome operator page shows27-11-2026 Fri02:16:41 poster with rock breakwater and open water. Play click yields Unable to play media; returns to same poster. No two updating frames; LIVE label not proof. Operator July27 article states usual view marina entrance and manual PTZ for weather; does not guarantee selected beaches. No stream URL stored.
